Floral Bouquet Calendar (MDF) – Eco-Friendly Desk Calendar with 12 Monthly Cards

The Floral Bouquet Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly is a beautifully crafted table accessory designed for homes, offices, workstations, and corporate desks. This premium MDF desk calendar features 12 monthly cards cut in a unique flower bunch shape (3.5″×7″), making it both functional and visually appealing. The thoughtfully integrated pen/pencil slot adds practicality and ensures your stationery stays organized. Each unit also includes a DIY MDF stand that you can assemble easily, making it an exciting element for customers who appreciate eco-friendly, reusable desk accessories.

This eco-conscious design positions the Floral Bouquet Calendar (MDF) Eco-Friendly as an ideal choice for sustainable gifting, corporate gifting, event giveaways, employee desk kits, and festive gift hampers. With growing demand for eco-friendly desk organizers, sustainable calendars, and reusable wooden table calendars, this product fits perfectly into a high-search-volume category of office accessories and corporate gifts. Its floral theme, compact size, and premium build quality appeal to users who want an aesthetic yet practical calendar for daily use.

Each monthly card showcases a different floral bouquet silhouette, giving a refreshing visual experience throughout the year. The 12 monthly cards cut in flower bunch shape (3.5″×7″) are printed to ensure long-lasting color retention, making your desk look beautiful while keeping your schedule close at hand. The DIY MDF stand is durable, stable, and crafted to complement the natural wood texture, enhancing the charm of the entire set. Whether placed on a corporate workstation, home desk, reception counter, or study table, this eco-friendly MDF calendar serves as both décor and utility.

This product also appeals to businesses looking for premium corporate gifts or branding-friendly desk calendars. The base can be customized with logos, brand names, messages, or campaign details, making it a high-value promotional item. The elegant floral design and compact size ensure that the occupies minimal space while still delivering a standout aesthetic. With more companies opting for sustainable gifting solutions, the stands out as a thoughtful and eco-conscious choice.

If you’re searching for an elegant, sustainable, and long-lasting table calendar, this model ticks all the boxes. Its, reusable structure, charming floral cards, and integrated pen holder make it a versatile accessory for everyday use. Designed to cater to the rising trend of nature-inspired office décor, this calendar helps enhance productivity while keeping your surroundings tidy and stylish.

Key Features

  • Made from premium MDF material for durability and eco-friendly usage
  • 12 monthly cards cut in flower bunch shape (3.5″×7″) for a decorative visual appeal
  • Integrated pen/pencil slot for added convenience on your desk
  • Includes an easy-to-assemble DIY MDF stand
  • Compact and elegant design suitable for home and office desks
  • Perfect for corporate gifts, employee welcome kits, event giveaways and festive gifting
  • Branding and customization available for bulk orders
  • Reusable, sustainable, and nature-inspired desk accessory

Why Choose?

The is much more than a calendar — it is a thoughtfully designed desk organizer that promotes sustainability and elevates workspace aesthetics. Its handcrafted feel, natural finish, and beautiful floral shapes make it suitable for modern offices, home workstations, and gifting occasions. If you want a functional yet decorative desk accessory that aligns with eco-conscious living, this calendar is the perfect choice.
